_readme: The source registry for the served knowledge base. Every input file the chunk build
reads must be claimed by a row here, and only licence class A may become chunks.
Classes are the AI4BCM guidance audit's R10 vocabulary (2026-09-10):
A              open licence permitting inclusion with attribution
A-share-alike  open but share-alike against the guidance's CC BY: quote, never chunk
B              free to read and quotable with attribution
Required on every row: id, title, edition, licence, licence_class, citation, paths.
A missing field is a build error, not a default. `edition: "@release"` means the
guidance release tag; `{edition}` and `{source_file}` in a citation are filled in per
chunk. Paths are fnmatch patterns where `*` crosses directory separators.
